# substratalctl command reference
{: .no_toc }

`substratalctl` is the Hub's command-line companion. It shares the Linux app's core, so it sends the same `Substratal-Version` header, signs in the same way and gets the same permission errors. See the [CLI tutorial]({{ '/tutorials/cli/' | relative_url }}).
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

## `substratalctl`

Command-line client for the Substratal Apps Platform API

**Usage:** `substratalctl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `health` — Check that the API is up (`GET /health`)
* `version` — Show this client's version, the API version it sends, and the base URL
* `login` — Sign in with email and password (and a TOTP code if two-factor is on)
* `logout` — Sign out and forget the saved session
* `whoami` — Show the signed-in user and their platform permissions
* `users` — Manage users
* `screens` — List the Hub's screens (IDs, routes, who can use them)
* `route` — Resolve a route or `substratal://` link to its screen
* `help-url` — Print the help-center URL for a screen ID, e.g. `USR-01`

###### **Options:**

* `--api <API>` — API environment: `production`, `local` (the devserver on :8080) or a base URL

  Default value: `production`
* `--no-keyring` — Don't use the Secret Service; you sign in again each run
* `--json` — Print JSON instead of a table



## `substratalctl health`

Check that the API is up (`GET /health`)

**Usage:** `substratalctl health`



## `substratalctl version`

Show this client's version, the API version it sends, and the base URL

**Usage:** `substratalctl version`



## `substratalctl login`

Sign in with email and password (and a TOTP code if two-factor is on)

**Usage:** `substratalctl login [OPTIONS] --email <EMAIL>`

###### **Options:**

* `--email <EMAIL>`
* `--password-env <VAR>` — Read the password from this environment variable instead of prompting



## `substratalctl logout`

Sign out and forget the saved session

**Usage:** `substratalctl logout`



## `substratalctl whoami`

Show the signed-in user and their platform permissions

**Usage:** `substratalctl whoami`



## `substratalctl users`

Manage users

**Usage:** `substratalctl users <COMMAND>`

###### **Subcommands:**

* `list` — List users (`GET /users`); needs `users.list`



## `substratalctl users list`

List users (`GET /users`); needs `users.list`

**Usage:** `substratalctl users list [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `-q`, `--query <QUERY>` — Search by name, email or `usr_` ID prefix
* `--limit <LIMIT>`

  Default value: `50`



## `substratalctl screens`

List the Hub's screens (IDs, routes, who can use them)

**Usage:** `substratalctl screens [OPTIONS]`

###### **Options:**

* `--all` — Include web-only screens (the Console)



## `substratalctl route`

Resolve a route or `substratal://` link to its screen

**Usage:** `substratalctl route <PATH>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<PATH>`



## `substratalctl help-url`

Print the help-center URL for a screen ID, e.g. `USR-01`

**Usage:** `substratalctl help-url <SCREEN_ID>`

###### **Arguments:**

* `<SCREEN_ID>`
